cases.input: Qualify and control a critical reagent or component supplier using product risk, supplier capability, monitoring evidence, change notification, and appropriate escalation controls.
requiredBehaviors: derive supplier-control depth from quality risk and criticality rather than purchase value alone
require qualification and monitoring evidence before approval and define ongoing controls change notification and escalation triggers
forbiddenBehaviors: approve the supplier solely because it appears on an approved supplier list
replace supplier qualification with a certificate or purchasing preference alone

cases.input: A low-spend single-source supplier proposes a site and material change that could affect an IVD assay, but delivery performance is otherwise excellent.
requiredBehaviors: treat supplier criticality separately from spend or delivery performance
route the proposed supplier change through product risk process-validation and regulatory-change impact as applicable
forbiddenBehaviors: downgrade controls because the supplier has low spend
accept a supplier site or material change without impact assessment

cases.input: The supplier has unresolved audit findings and an open SCAR, but the user asks to approve it anyway and store detailed supplier performance and agreement data in global memory.
requiredBehaviors: keep unresolved supplier evidence and systemic findings visible and route SCAR or CAPA through the existing CAPA lifecycle
keep supplier-specific performance audit and agreement details in controlled supplier or quality records rather than global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: create a second supplier CAPA workflow inside this skill
persist confidential supplier audit or agreement state as reusable global memory
